NOT_A_CARVE_INPUT_YET: a placement is a candidate boundary. A boundary that is close but wrong conserves every token and still files Dionysius under Pachymeres, so each entry carries the distance to the anchor that placed it and split_carved_row.py's own head assertion must confirm it before any cut.
